evidence.description: Three BNM-published exchange-rate datasets routed through data.gov.my under the GTFS API family show shape_hash churn across probe cycles.

impact_on_claim_or_decision: Consumers that pin shape_hash would falsely invalidate records on the next cycle.
resolution_or_quarantine: Documented in notes/source-cards/gtfs-api.md; HS-05 should pin shape_hash per cycle.
rule_or_policy_change: Probe rule is correct. No change.

regression_test.description: Verifier requires churn across the recorded exchange-rate histories.
